title: Song of Songs – The Bride and Groom's First Songs
description: In the first chapters of the Song of Songs, the bride and groom take turns singing about their love. The bride longs for her beloved, describes herself as dark but beautiful, and is compared to a lily among thorns. The groom calls her to arise and come when spring breaks forth.

versions.title: Song of Solomon – The Bride and Groom
versions.description: The Song of Songs portrays the intense love between the bride and groom in poetic images of longing, seeking, and reunion.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The Song of Songs is a collection of poetic dialogues without a clear narrative structure. Limiting it to chapters 1–2 is somewhat arbitrary but provides a defined poetic unit.; [minor] description: The description is general and covers the entire Song of Songs, not just chapters 1–2.
